purpose.domain_detail: Tribunal jury management system (ProjetGesTrib) managing jurors, convocations, hearings, cases, and courtrooms
purpose.summary: A menu-driven batch application for managing a tribunal (court) system. It handles CRUD operations on jurors (jurés), convocations, hearing sessions (séances), legal cases (affaires), and courtrooms (salles). The program is partially implemented, with several stubs marked with author initials (Alvin, Oriane, Mathieu).

notable_features: INDEXED files with multiple ALTERNATE RECORD KEYs
PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL loops
Partially implemented stubs (empty paragraphs with double period)
Multiple indexed and sequential file types mixed
START verb with KEY EQUALS for alternate key navigation
verdict.notes: This is clearly a student group project (authors Alvin, Oriane, Mathieu noted in comments). Many paragraphs are stubs (e.g. ModifierConvocation.., SupprimerConvocation.., ConsulterSeances.. etc. with double period and only a comment). The program uses French throughout. Two lines exceed 72 columns. The double-period paragraph terminators on stubs are a GnuCOBOL/free-format convention. Overall confidence in COBOL identification is high; dialect confidence is medium as no explicit compiler directives are present.
